prompt: I keep manually turning my messy meeting notes into clean action item lists for my team afterward, and it takes forever. I want a skill that does this so I don't have to reformat it every time. Can you help me spec this out — I want a proper written spec and rubric before I actually build it, not just a quick chat.

assertions.text: Exactly one SPECS.md and one RUBRIC.md were produced (no v1/v2 or side-by-side alternates)
SPECS.md contains all required sections: Purpose, Trigger conditions, Inputs, Outputs, Scope & boundaries, Non-goals, Edge cases, Open assumptions
SPECS.md content is specific to meeting-notes-to-action-items (not generic boilerplate that could apply to any skill)
RUBRIC.md's first criterion is triggering accuracy and covers both firing correctly and staying quiet on near-misses
RUBRIC.md has 4-6 criteria total, each traceable to a specific part of SPECS.md, plus an Overall score section
Transcript shows a self-evaluation pass (Step 5) happening before the documents are presented as final
Transcript shows at least one round of simulated user feedback followed by a revision (Step 6 loop actually exercised, not a single-shot output)
No SKILL.md-style content (frontmatter, imperative build instructions) appears anywhere in the output
